part1.script: Breaking news. Tesla chief executive Elon Musk showed a Roadster car that he says can fly, flipping it in the air by remote control in Texas.
part1.what: showed a Roadster car he says can fly; it flipped in the air under remote control at a livestreamed event in Texas
part1.why: his claim that it is the world's first flying car

part2.script: Tesla promises production in twenty twenty eight, but nobody outside Tesla has tested its claims, and no final price has been announced.
part2.why: the claims are untested by anyone outside Tesla and the final price is not announced
